user.title: mBenzin access key
user.description: Enter your personal access key for mBenzin.cz. You can get it for free by e-mail: write to reklama@mbenzin.cz, say you use the prices in Home Assistant, for which city or stations, and how often you load them. The key is personal, never share it. Ceny paliv is an independent project; the prices come from mBenzin.cz, which is not involved in this integration.

data_description.key: The key mBenzin.cz sent you. Paste it whole, without spaces.

area_mode.title: Search area
area_mode.description: Choose the original city list or a GPS circle. GPS uses only Home Assistant's configured location, a saved zone, a point selected on the map, or manually entered coordinates.

location_method.title: GPS area centre
location_method.description: Choose how to set the centre of the search area. No phone location or GPS tracker is used.

location_zone.title: Saved Home Assistant zone
location_zone.description: Select an existing zone. Its coordinates are read again when the zone changes; deleting the zone leaves the GPS results empty until it is restored or another method is selected.

location_map.title: Choose a point on the map
location_map.description: Tap or drag the marker to choose the centre. The map is prefilled with the saved point or Home Assistant's configured home location.

location_manual.title: Manual GPS coordinates
location_manual.description: Advanced option. Latitude must be between −90 and 90; longitude between −180 and 180.

gps_radius.title: GPS search radius
gps_radius.description: Choose a radius from 5 to 50 km. The default is 40 km.

city.title: City
city.description: Choose your city. Only the stations of this city are shown, not those of the whole region.

fuels.title: Fuels and language
fuels.description: Pick one or more fuels – for example Natural 95 and LPG for a dual-fuel car. Each fuel gets its own sensors. Note that mBenzin does not distinguish E10: the Natural 95 price applies to all 95-octane petrol.

data_description.language: Sets the language of the labels in the ready-made dashboard views (for example "My station"). The language of this setup follows Home Assistant's language.

station.title: Favourite station – {fuel}
station.description: Your usual station in {city} for {fuel}. It gets its own sensor with price history, trends and its rank in town. Leave "—" for none.

logos.title: Station logos (optional)
logos.description: Tick the chains whose logos you want on the card. They are downloaded from the Ceny paliv logo pack on GitHub into your Home Assistant config folder (a few KB each). The chains of your city are preselected. Logos are trademarks of their owners and are shown only to identify the stations; this project is not affiliated with them. Untick everything to use letter badges instead.

reauth_confirm.title: New mBenzin access key
reauth_confirm.description: mBenzin.cz no longer accepts the access key of this configuration. Enter a valid key: your settings, price history and sensors stay as they are.

data_description.key: The key mBenzin.cz sent you. Paste it whole, without spaces.

reconfigure.title: Change the mBenzin access key
reconfigure.description: Enter the new access key. Your settings, price history and sensors stay as they are.
